items.exampleEn: The singer has a contract with a record company in Japan.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手和日本的一家唱片公司簽了約。

items.exampleEn: Many corporate offices are empty on weekends.
items.exampleZh: 很多公司辦公室在週末都空無一人。

items.exampleEn: The bakery makes most of its profit from wedding cakes.
items.exampleZh: 那家麵包店大部分的利潤來自婚禮蛋糕。

items.exampleEn: Your participation in the survey will help us improve.
items.exampleZh: 你參與這份問卷，能幫助我們改進。

items.exampleEn: Good marketing can turn a simple product into a bestseller.
items.exampleZh: 好的行銷能讓一個簡單的產品變成暢銷商品。

items.exampleEn: The farm has been a family enterprise for three generations.
items.exampleZh: 這座農場是傳了三代的家族事業。

items.exampleEn: Her father owns a large stake in the hotel.
items.exampleZh: 她父親持有那家飯店大量的股份。

items.sentenceEn: Please read the contract carefully before you sign it.
items.sentenceZh: 簽約之前，請仔細閱讀合約。

items.audioEn: Our marketing team will show the new advertisements at Thursday's meeting.
items.audioZh: 我們的行銷團隊會在星期四的會議上展示新廣告。
items.questionZh: 行銷團隊在星期四的會議上要展示什麼？

items.sentenceEn: The company made a profit of two million dollars last year.
items.sentenceZh: 那家公司去年獲利兩百萬美元。

items.sentenceEn: Student participation in the cleaning day was higher than ever.
items.sentenceZh: 學生參加打掃日的人數比以往都多。

items.stemEn: The sports company bought a thirty percent ____ in the new shoe brand.
items.stemZh: 那家運動用品公司買下了新鞋牌百分之三十的股份。

items.stemEn: Many ____ customers order lunch boxes for their staff meetings.
items.stemZh: 許多企業客戶會為員工會議訂便當。

items.passageEn: Every year, a large shoe enterprise in Tainan holds a charity run, and its marketing team plans the whole event. This year, over five thousand people took part, and participation by families doubled. Each runner paid a small fee, and the company promised to give all the profit from the day to a children's library. Several corporate teams also ran together, wearing the same T-shirts. A local radio station signed a contract to report the race live. A nearby gym, in which the company has a small stake, let the runners use its showers for free. Some workers even spent part of their salary on drinks for the runners.
items.passageZh: 每年，台南一家大型製鞋企業都會舉辦公益路跑，由行銷團隊規劃整個活動。今年有超過五千人參加，家庭的參與人數增加了一倍。每位跑者付一小筆報名費，公司承諾把當天的所有利潤捐給一間兒童圖書館。還有好幾支企業隊伍穿著同樣的 T 恤一起跑。一家地方電台簽了合約，現場轉播這場路跑。附近一家健身房（公司持有它的一小部分股份）免費讓跑者使用淋浴間。有些員工甚至花了部分薪水買飲料給跑者。

questions.questionZh: 今年的路跑有什麼不同？
options: 參加的家庭增加了一倍
路線經過台南市的每一個區

questions.questionZh: 公司答應把當天的利潤怎麼處理？

items.promptZh: 她在一家大公司負責行銷工作。
referenceEn: She is in charge of marketing at a large company.
She is responsible for marketing at a big company.
rubricZh: 「負責」可寫，例如 be in charge of、be responsible for、handle 等

items.promptZh: 這位足球員和球隊續簽了三年的合約。
referenceEn: The football player signed a new three-year contract with the team.
The footballer has signed a new three-year contract with his team.
rubricZh: 「續簽合約」可寫，例如 signed a new contract、renewed his contract 等
「三年的」可寫，例如 a three-year contract、a contract for three years 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 signed、has signed 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："Last year, a small drink enterprise in Tainan signed a contract with a large supermarket chain. To sell more, its marketing team created a contest: customers could design a new bottle label online. Participation was much higher than expected, with over ten thousand designs. The winning design came from a nurse who drew her hometown's old train station. Sales rose quickly, and the company's profit doubled. A bigger drink company then bought a small stake in the business. The owner says she will use the money to raise every worker's salary and to sponsor corporate events for charities."；改後："Every year, a large shoe enterprise in Tainan holds a charity run, and its marketing team plans the whole event. This year, over five thousand people took part, and participation by families doubled. Each runner paid a small fee, and the company promised to give all the profit from the day to a children's library. Several corporate teams also ran together, wearing the same T-shirts. A local radio station signed a contract to report the race live. A nearby gym, in which the company has a small stake, let the runners use its showers for free. Some workers even spent part of their salary on drinks for the runners."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："去年，台南一家小型飲料企業和一家大型連鎖超市簽了約。為了提高銷量，它的行銷團隊辦了一場比賽：顧客可以上網設計新的瓶身標籤。參與的人遠比預期多，收到超過一萬件設計。獲勝的作品來自一位護理師，她畫了家鄉的老火車站。銷量很快上升，公司的利潤也翻了一倍。後來，一家更大的飲料公司買下了這家企業的一小部分股份。老闆說，她會用這筆錢替每位員工加薪，並贊助公益性質的企業活動。"；改後："每年，台南一家大型製鞋企業都會舉辦公益路跑，由行銷團隊規劃整個活動。今年有超過五千人參加，家庭的參與人數增加了一倍。每位跑者付一小筆報名費，公司承諾把當天的所有利潤捐給一間兒童圖書館。還有好幾支企業隊伍穿著同樣的 T 恤一起跑。一家地方電台簽了合約，現場轉播這場路跑。附近一家健身房（公司持有它的一小部分股份）免費讓跑者使用淋浴間。有些員工甚至花了部分薪水買飲料給跑者。"
